column1: # retrieval-budget prompt set for this repository.
# Each row is a question someone actually asks of this spec, and the terms are
# the content words that question would be searched with - not strings chosen
# to make the budget small. The budget each one costs is a measurement of this
# spec, including where its own vocabulary is high-frequency and expensive.
# The set spans all five EARS patterns and one SUPERSEDED requirement (R14),
# because a citation that lands on a superseded sentence has to be reachable
# too - that is what R3 keeps the original text in the file for.
